scope: Offline system repair following one authorized same-project paid revision; no paid rerun, production frontend, Claude Code or real game edits.

handoff: Added read-only measure.mjs --inspect <request-id>; no model/build/browser/CAS mutation.
Original measurement request replay now returns actual current input freshness and exits nonzero when stale/incomplete/failed/superseded.
Preview/export and in-turn inspection share the same current-input predicate; ended/quiesced writer remains required for delivery paths.
Final native settlement computes current measurement status in blockedReason after owned work stops; no extra model summary, source rewrite or automatic retry.
Receipt stays in host Run/export evidence; help and result no longer imply copying mechanical ID/hash to a measured report. Changed reports are named explicitly.
verification: Preview Node helper automatically counts page/console/request/HTTP errors before first navigation, including child game frames, regardless of author-installed listeners. No raw error payloads or URLs are copied to host logs.
Existing beforeNavigate hook still controls route overrides/recordings; no late reload masquerades as initial navigation.
Existing layout CLI produces current input hashes and exact geometry. Added synthetic camera/zoom regression contrasting a wrong coordinate within a wide sample with exact source-derived bounds.
Preserved source/requirement/artifact/report/dependency version checks, old failed reservations, no superseded fallback and no quality PASS inference.

quality.progress: Reliable provenance and startup observations improved; existing geometry capabilities reused rather than introducing a semantic/aesthetic gate.
remaining: Actual professional design and Skill use
Original and mutated data checks in real saved game
Representative art/action feedback and actual audio observation

tokens.progress: Host final receipt and read-only inspection remove a need for model-only receipt work and accidental rebuild replay. No fixed eight-document review or new model round.
tokens.remaining: Large native history and author/reviewer fine-grained operations remain. Do not claim the prior 4,783,209-token handoff window eliminated; no paid comparable measurement.

restrictedSandbox.reason: Loopback listeners and isolated build unavailable in restricted sandbox; retained as environment failure, reran same source with explicit permitted local access.

finalBatches.notes: Real existing native CLI with fixed loopback model; synthetic debug project only. Path escape and incomplete settlement logs are expected negative cases.

limits: An author can still modify reports after measurement. Current checks identify and reject that state, not guarantee model compliance.
Zero startup errors do not prove complete runtime paths or game quality; counts do not localize errors or replace recording detail.
Geometry is a deterministic oracle for supported semantics, not automatic verification of custom runtime consumers.
Read-only freshness is a current observation, not a file lock; later edits invalidate it.
Prior stuck-compression provider/network cause and actual total-token reduction remain unproved.
Changes are source/offline verified, not deployed through a normal service restart this turn.
